bugs_found: cmd_review_gate does not enforce its documented requirement that the latest round file overall has verdict=approve; it only checks the latest code-reviewer verdict, so a later math-auditor request-changes round can incorrectly pass.

cmd_review_gate claims findings are deduped using the latest ack, but sorted(branch_dir.glob(...)) orders filenames lexicographically, so round-10 can be processed before round-2 and stale findings/acks may overwrite newer ones.
load_profile consumers assume yaml.safe_load returns a dict; empty or non-mapping .banking-profile files can raise AttributeError instead of returning the documented configuration-error exit code.

cmd_review_validate loads manifest/findings schemas without catching FileNotFoundError or JSONDecodeError, unlike profile validation, so schema installation/configuration errors can crash with a traceback.
